capacity_note: Printed meter is 6/8 throughout; only the system-1 opening glyph on both staves. Complete regions have capacity 3 quarter-note units (six eighths). P001 is a one-eighth opening pickup (capacity 1/2). P009 is the five-eighth first-strain terminal (capacity 5/2). P010 is a one-eighth second-strain pickup (capacity 1/2). P030 is the five-eighth second-strain close (capacity 5/2). Two conventional pairs: P001+P009 = 3 and P010+P030 = 3, each matching printed 6/8. No rest is invented in P009.
